announcement.title: Scarlet 0.6.1 is available
announcement.message:
Scarlet 0.6.1 — stable release

Scarlet 0.6.1 is available now. Review the release notes before updating.

Before updating:
• Keep an independent backup and close the old Scarlet process.
• Java 21 is recommended.
• If login fails temporarily, do not choose to reset your saved data.
• Review the release notes for requirements and known limitations.

Use Open link for the release notes and downloads.
